method: Frozen class network plus nearest reviewed negative/positive support ratio veto. Threshold selected on validation only.

policy.selection: Minimize unknown validation acceptances subject to supported-letter retention; break ties toward the smallest rejection ratio. Require fewer unknown validation acceptances than baseline. Test data never select the threshold.

limitations: Visual review by Codex, not ASL expert certification.
Partial flexion is a proxy; intended incomplete signs are not annotated.
Still images/cropped resting hands do not establish live webcam reliability.
Unknown physical hands, lighting and camera angles.
Legacy known-letter split lacks signer IDs. Public known/unknown splits are source-participant-disjoint.
Dataset rejection labels cover the alphabet only; some unsupported shapes are valid numbers or signs.
A handshape identical to a valid letter cannot be rejected based on intent alone.
Small, correlated categories; no universal open-set accuracy claim.
